name: DhirDhar Solution v2.1.5
changelog:
DhirDhar Solution v2.1.5 Release Notes:

### Borrower Management & QR Workflow
- Post-Save QR Popup: Immediate centered modal upon saving a new borrower with instant Cancel, Save QR, and Print QR actions directly leading back to Dashboard.
- Automatic Account QR generation and high-resolution POS printing with Windows print subsystem integration.

### Keyboard Shortcuts & Usability
- F1 Shortcut: Directly navigates to Add Borrower and automatically focuses the Full Name input field with caret positioned ready for immediate typing in English, Gujarati, or Hindi.
- Clean Dashboard Quick Actions: Visual F1-F4 badge indicators removed from the four cards while keeping all F1, F2, F3, F4, Ctrl+F, and ESC keyboard accelerators fully functional.

### Multilingual & Typing Stability
- Full support for English, Gujarati, Gujarati phonetic transliteration, and Hindi without IME interference.
- Immutable borrower numbering and business profile prefix integrity.

### Security & Distribution
- Hardware-backed authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM) and verified runtime application integrity.
- Windows x64 production installer: DhirDhar-2.1.5-x64-Setup.exe (Version 2.1.5).
